paragraphs.text: 1. HEAVEN and Earth, first by everlasting Order, speakers of truth, are near enough to hear us,
paragraphs.original: द्यावा ह क्षामा प्रथमे ऋतेनाभिश्रावे भवतः सत्यवाचा ।
paragraphs.translit: dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame ṛtenābhiśrāve bhavataḥ satyavācā |

paragraphs.text: When the God, urging men to worship. sitteth as Priest, assuming all his vital vigour.
2. As God comprising Gods by Law Eternal, bear, as the Chief who knoweth, our oblation,
paragraphs.original: देवो देवान्परिभूरृतेन वहा नो हव्यं प्रथमश्चिकित्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: devo devānparibhūrṛtena vahā no havyaṃ prathamaścikitvān |

paragraphs.text: Smoke-bannered with the fuel, radiant, joyous, better to praise and worship, Priest for ever.
paragraphs.original: धूमकेतुः समिधा भाऋजीको मन्द्रो होता नित्यो वाचा यजीयान्
paragraphs.translit: dhūmaketuḥ samidhā bhāṛjīko mandro hotā nityo vācā yajīyān

paragraphs.text: 3. When the cow's nectar wins the God completely, men here below are heaven's sustainers.
paragraphs.original: स्वावृग्देवस्यामृतं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्त उर्वी ।
paragraphs.translit: svāvṛgdevasyāmṛtaṃ yadī gorato jātāso dhārayanta urvī |

paragraphs.text: All the Gods came to this thy heavenly Yajus which from the motley Pair milked oil and water.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे देवा अनु तत्ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनी दिव्यं घृतं वाः
paragraphs.translit: viśve devā anu tatte yajurgurduhe yadenī divyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. 1 praise your work that ye may make me prosper: hear, Heaven and Earth, Twain Worlds that drop with fatness.
paragraphs.original: अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घृतस्नू द्यावाभूमी शृणुतं रोदसी मे ।
paragraphs.translit: arcāmi vāṃ vardhāyāpo ghṛtasnū dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me |

paragraphs.text: While days and nights go to the world of spirits, here let the Parents with sweet meath refresh us
paragraphs.original: अहा यद्द्यावोऽसुनीतिमयन्मध्वा नो अत्र पितरा शिशीताम्
paragraphs.translit: ahā yaddyāvo'sunītimayanmadhvā no atra pitarā śiśītām

paragraphs.text: 5. Hath the King siezed us? How have we offended against his holy ordinance? Who knoweth?
paragraphs.original: किं स्विन्नो राजा जगृहे कदस्याति व्रतं चकृमा को वि वेद ।
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ svinno rājā jagṛhe kadasyāti vrataṃ cakṛmā ko vi veda |

paragraphs.text: For even Mitra mid the Gods is angry there are both song and strength for those who come not.
paragraphs.original: मित्रश्चिद्धि ष्मा जुहुराणो देवाञ्छ्लोको न यातामपि वाजो अस्ति
paragraphs.translit: mitraściddhi ṣmā juhurāṇo devāñchloko na yātāmapi vājo asti

paragraphs.text: 6. 'Tis hard to understand the Immortal's nature, where she who is akin becomes a stranger.
Guard ceaselessly, great Agni, him who ponders Yama's name, easy to be comprehended.
paragraphs.original: यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तमृष्व पाह्यप्रयुच्छन्
paragraphs.translit: yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamṛṣva pāhyaprayucchan

paragraphs.text: 7. They in the synod where the Gods rejoice them, where they are seated in Vivasvan's dwelling,
paragraphs.original: यस्मिन्देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते ।
paragraphs.translit: yasmindevā vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante |

paragraphs.text: Have given the Moon his beams, the Sun his splendour-the Two unweariedly maintain their brightness.
8. The counsel which the Gods meet to consider, their secret plan,-of that we have no knowledge.
paragraphs.original: यस्मिन्देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये न वयमस्य विद्म ।
paragraphs.translit: yasmindevā manmani saṃcarantyapīcye na vayamasya vidma |

paragraphs.text: There let God Savitar, Aditi, and Mitra proclaim to Varuna that we are sinless.
paragraphs.original: मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान्सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत्
paragraphs.translit: mitro no atrāditiranāgānsavitā devo varuṇāya vocat

paragraphs.text: 9. Hear us, O Agni, in your comninn dwelling: harness thy rapid car, the car of Amrta.
paragraphs.original: श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum |

paragraphs.text: Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.
paragraphs.original: आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः
paragraphs.translit: ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ
